# OpenProgram 0.6.1 Release Notes

Original version date: August 15, 2026. This tag tested the new formal distribution workflow, but the build did not complete. It did not publish installable assets and is not an installable user version.

## ✨ Planned release content

- Standardized the release structure for macOS Desktop and macOS/Linux CLI/server packages.
- Defined a self-contained runtime with managed CPython and complete first-party capabilities for ordinary users.
- Added platform runtimes, Desktop packaging, checksums, manifests, and installation verification.
- Added a short installation command and platform-specific installation documentation.

## ⚠️ Release status

- The complete Intel macOS runtime did not satisfy the release requirements.
- No GitHub Release or installable runtime assets were published.
- All planned changes were superseded by the successful `v0.6.6` Release.

## 🔄 Version guide

- Previous stable version: [`v0.6.0`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/tag/v0.6.0)
